title: Brief v1
description: Canonical machine representation of a well-formed `.brief.md` (format version 1). This is the JSON object produced by `brief emit json` after parse. The authoring form remains Markdown with YAML frontmatter; see docs/brief-format.md and docs/schema/SPEC.md. The parser is tolerant and will still emit a ParsedBrief for malformed files — this schema is the validity contract (`brief validate` / E1).

goal.description: The H1 heading. Exactly one H1 is required in a valid brief; the parser stores an empty string when missing.

identity.description: Optional `## Identity` section. JSON `null` when absent.

sacred.description: `## Sacred` entries. Each names a protected path glob and why it must not be modified.

deliverable.description: Free-text `## Deliverable` (what done looks like). JSON `null` when the section is absent or empty.

unknown_sections.description: Unrecognized H2 sections, preserved verbatim for extensibility. Not reframed at emit time.

stack.description: Technologies, languages, frameworks. Required and non-empty on a valid brief. Defaults to `[]` if omitted in YAML.

context.description: File paths or URLs of reference material. Optional. `brief validate` warns if a path does not exist.

model.description: Preferred model identifier (task-specific hint, not a session or runtime config).

brief_version.description: `.brief.md` format version. Authored as `brief_version:` (the legacy `version:` spelling still deserializes). Defaults to `"1"` when omitted in YAML. An unknown value is a `brief validate` error (E1-S2).

skill_name.description: kebab-case name for an emitted Agent Skill.

skill_description.description: One-line description for an emitted Agent Skill.

FrontmatterAuthoring.title: YAML frontmatter as JSON (authoring)
FrontmatterAuthoring.description: Shape of the YAML block at the top of `.brief.md` before parse defaults. Unknown keys are ignored (forward-compatible). New keys must clear the YAGNI bar in docs/design/frontmatter-additions.md. Execution-implying keys (session, tools, decoding, tool-loop) are not part of this format.

version.description: Deprecated spelling of `brief_version`, still accepted at parse time.

hard.description: `### Hard` — non-negotiable. Must hold, or the agent aborts.

ask_first.description: `### Ask First` — requires human approval before proceeding.

text.description: Plain-language constraint. Emitters reframe by register; the source is not RFC-2119.

scope.description: Glob patterns this constraint applies to. Omitted when empty (project-wide). Authoring: optional leading `[`glob`, …]` on the list item (docs/brief-format.md §8.1).

path.description: Protected path glob. Authoring wraps the path in backticks.

reason.description: Why the path must not be modified. Separator in authoring is an em dash or `--`.

well_formed.description: True when the source item had a backtick-wrapped path plus a separator. A valid brief requires this to be true.

has_checkbox.description: True when the source item used Markdown checkbox syntax. A valid brief requires this to be true.

heading.description: Recognized H2 name. The parser only treats `## Identity` as this section.
The H2 text of an unrecognized section (e.g. Commands, Code Style, Architecture).

content.description: Raw Markdown body of the section, preserved as authored.
